3	We document a descriptive regime transition in LLM judge panel vulnerability: individual weakness ($\eta_{\max}$) dominates at $K{=}3$; at $K{\geq}5$, diversity structure ($K_{\mathrm{eff}}$) becomes the primary predictor.
